lines.2: Subaru was asleep on the sofa.
lines.3: That guy really did whatever he pleased.
lines.6: 「Tears of joy... I can't believe this gathering of all the school's most beautiful girls is going to be mine.」
lines.7: 「That's one hell of a leap. You'd have to warp through several dimensions to arrive at that conclusion.」
lines.8: 「Oh, Fukahire, could you go buy us some drinks from the cafeteria? The fridge is empty. Orange juice for me.」
lines.14: 「See? The girls are showing an interest in me, aren't they?」
lines.15: 「Looks to me like they're just using you as an errand boy...」
lines.16: 「All right. Tsushima, you're on vice-president duties.」
lines.18: 「For starters, go over this with Kinu. At least learn the school regulations and how the student council is organized.」
lines.19: She smoothly handed me the rule book.
lines.20: 「Got it. I admit, I've never paid any attention to this stuff before.」
lines.21: 「Ask me if there is anything you do not understand.」
lines.22: 「Okay, let's read it on the sofa. ...Hey, move it, Subaru.」
lines.23: Kinu kicked the sleeping Subaru off the sofa.
lines.27: Subaru obediently retreated to the end of the sofa.
lines.29: 「Well, he's pretty much my underling, Mark III.」
lines.32: 「Ellie, everything's ready. Go ahead and teach Yashi.」
lines.33: 「All right, time for your private lesson.」
